name: Resist The Wave
summary:
The world is on the brink of collapse. Wave after wave, nightmarish creatures emerge from the shadows to destroy you. Your mission: survive, resist, and fight back.

In Resist the Wave, every shot counts. Aim precisely, dodge attacks, and use sprinting to reposition yourself while managing your arsenal. The action unfolds in a vibrant, top-down 3D world designed specifically for Meta Quest.

Forge your path through 8 (Early Access) levels of increasing difficulty.

Devastatingly Powerful Special Weapons: Pu
